name: JoAi: Delete Artifact

description.en: Permanently delete a delivery artifact record. Does not revoke already-sent messages.
description.de: Löscht einen Lieferartefakt-Eintrag dauerhaft. Bereits gesendete Nachrichten werden nicht zurückgenommen.

bot: Use only when an artifact was created by mistake. Prefer status archived for soft retirement.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
